tips: TIPS: Remind the goal, don't get lost. Clearly manage the picture of your working progress. If you get lost, say so promptly, and stop.
TIPS: Jump out. Take a look at the whole work's state. Make sure the whole picture is still in your control.
TIPS: Don't get stuck in a narrow line of thought. Don't be dragged too far by a superficial observation.
TIPS: A good inference has rigid deduction chain. If you say A causes B, there must be no hidden C in the middle.
TIPS: Don't make illusion correlation, such as A happens first, B happends later. Then A is the reason of B. This is super dangerous.
TIPS: A root cause can not only explain the current question, but can also predict real things.
